aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description:
I have built websites with React and mobile apps with React Native, visited from different places around the world, like the one you're visiting right now or my own app Ez-PDF.

With the 5 years of experience I have as a Developer, I decided to implement AI in an application built with React Native to make it easier for you to summarize PDF files.

I'm looking for my next challenge, one that will be of {{region}} caliber, building applications with the best practices every project deserves, like clean code, CI/CD, or SOLID.

oscargarza.title: Personal projects
oscargarza.description:
This website has one goal: to showcase my professional profile in the tech field.

I built it with the following 3 priorities in mind:

  1. Fast deployment of updates.
  2. Low development and maintenance cost.
  3. Accessibility for audiences across different languages.

With this in mind, I designed the infrastructure with React ↗ for development, GitHub Pages ↗ for hosting, the CLI gh-pages ↗ for deployment, and Cloudflare ↗ for the custom domain's DNS. Additionally, I integrated the i18next ↗ library to achieve translation into English, Spanish, and French.
